fr.sorbonne_u.components.cyphy.utils.aclocks

Class AcceleratedAndSimulationClock

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.utils.aclocks.AcceleratedClock
      • fr.sorbonne_u.components.cyphy.utils.aclocks.AcceleratedAndSimulationClock
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable

    public class AcceleratedAndSimulationClock
extends fr.sorbonne_u.utils.aclocks.AcceleratedClock
    The class AcceleratedAndSimulationClock extends the class AcceleratedClock with the simulation capabilities i.e., managing a real time simulation starting after the launch of the application to synchronise components actions with the simulated runs.

    Description

    Implementation Invariants

     invariant       realTimeDelayToStartSimulationInNanos > 0
 invariant       simulatedStartTime != null
 invariant       simulatedDuration != null
 invariant       simulatedStartTime.getTimeUnit().equals(simulatedDuration.getTimeUnit())
 invariant       simulatedStartTime.getTimeUnit().equals(simulatedTimeUnit)

    Invariants

     invariant

    Created on : 2024-11-19

    Jacques Malenfant

    • Constructor Detail

      • AcceleratedAndSimulationClock

        public AcceleratedAndSimulationClock(java.lang.String clockURI,
                                     long unixEpochStartTimeInNanos,
                                     java.time.Instant startInstant,
                                     double accelerationFactor,
                                     fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.time.Time simulatedStartTime,
                                     fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.time.Duration simulatedDuration)
                              throws fr.sorbonne_u.exceptions.VerboseException
        create an accelerated and simulation clock with the given acceleration factor and the given delay to start the simulation, taking the start instant and the start time as now.

        Contract

         pre     clockURI != null && !clockURI.isEmpty()
 pre     unixEpochStartTimeInNanos > 0
 pre     startInstant != null
 pre     accelerationFactor > 0.0
 pre     simulatedStartTime != null
 pre     simulatedDuration != null && simulatedDuration.getSimulatedDuration() > 0.0
 pre     simulatedStartTime.getTimeUnit().equals(simulatedDuration.getTimeUnit())
 post    getStartEpochNanos() == unixEpochStartTimeInNanos
 post    getStartInstant().equals(startInstant)
 post    getEndInstant() != null && getEndInstant().isAfter(getStartInstant())
 post    getAccelerationFactor() == accelerationFactor
        Parameters:
        clockURI - URI attributed to the clock.
        unixEpochStartTimeInNanos - start time in Unix epoch time in nanoseconds.
        startInstant - start time as Instant.
        accelerationFactor - acceleration factor to be applied.
        simulatedStartTime - start time of the simulation, in simulated logical time.
        simulatedDuration - duration of the simulation, in simulated time.
        Throws:
        fr.sorbonne_u.exceptions.VerboseException - to do.
